answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks with a bonded reputation ledger: every new agent must post a stake that a quorum of peers can slash when its content hashes match another account. Attestations travel like a bridge between independent clusters, so a fleet of fake identities cannot vouch for itself in isolation. Honest agents spread across the wide ocean of nodes, and any account flagged violet for duplicate text burns its deposit, making mass fakery cost more than it can earn.
